title: The ET-SoC-1, interactively
description: Esperanto's ET-SoC-1, a chip for machine learning, as a clickable, animated schematic: the die with its mesh of shires, a shire's cache and minions, a minion's units, and twelve data flows played stage by stage (a load to DRAM, the latency ladder, TensorSend, the relay, gathers and scatters, the host over PCIe, a matmul on the tensor unit, the same matmul's watts and heat on different data, one hot line, the allreduce tree, one value broadcast to every minion four ways, and TensorFMA32: one flipped input bit's avalanche of toggles through a lane's seven-stage multiply-add), with the latency, bandwidth, energy and heat measured on three cards, each number with its source and each inferred part with what would settle it; an 18-slide tour for presenting; and a zoom from the lab's rack down the chip's parts and circuits, the multiply-add as built, a FinFET at TSMC N7's numbers, its fin and channel, to an atom, its nucleus and a proton's quarks: double-click any part to go in, ↑ Zoom out to go out.
card_description: Esperanto's ET-SoC-1 as a clickable, animated schematic: twelve data flows, measured on three cards (TensorFMA32 simulated from the design), an 18-slide tour, and a zoom from the rack to the quarks.
